title: Kosaraju SCC output decides acyclicity: a general SCC-sequence lemma specialised to Kosaraju
intent: Establish that the Kosaraju SCC sequence characterises acyclicity (kosaraju_acyclic =1 @acyclic) by proving the equivalence once for an arbitrary SCC sequence satisfying three abstract hypotheses, then specialising to Kosaraju and discharging the hypotheses with kosaraju_correct.

children.name: sccs_acyclicE
children.closed_by: apply: (sameP allP); apply: (equivP acyclicP); rewrite -(rwP preacyclic_sccsP)
children.note: Proved in section AcyclicSCCS for an arbitrary scc_seq with hypotheses uniq_flatten, all_in_flatten and class_symconnect; sccs_acyclic and g are section-local. After the rewrite the proof splits into the two directions, closing the forward one with class_acyclicP and the backward one with acyclicP. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: For any SCC sequence, being acyclic on every component equals the graph being acyclic.

children.name: kosaraju_correct
children.statement:
Lemma kosaraju_correct :
  let l := flatten kosaraju in
  [/\ uniq l, forall i, i \in l &
     forall c : seq T, c \in kosaraju ->
      exists x, forall y, (y \in c) = symconnect r x y].
children.note: Supplies exactly the three hypotheses of section AcyclicSCCS for scc_seq := @kosaraju V: uniq (flatten kosaraju), every vertex appears, and each component is a symconnect class. Proved by induction over tseq, closing the three goals with pdfs_connect, tseq_correct and the recursion hypotheses. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: The Kosaraju sequence is uniq, covers every vertex, and its components are symconnect classes.

applicability.goal_shape: A theorem about a concrete structure (kosaraju's SCC output) that is already true of an arbitrary structure of the same kind (any scc_seq satisfying three hypotheses); the concrete instance is obtained by instantiating a section variable.
applicability.use_when: Several algorithms or instances share a proof that depends only on an abstract interface (here an SCC sequence with the three facts); the interface can be stated as section variables and hypotheses, the shared lemma proved once, and each concrete case closed by discharging the hypotheses.
applicability.avoid_when: The concrete instances need different arguments, or each instance's correctness lemma does not already expose the interface facts in the exact shape the general lemma assumes; if the generalised statement has to be weakened to fit every instance, the instantiation no longer yields the original strength.

consequences: The move splits the work into (a) proving the general lemma once over the abstract scc_seq and its three hypotheses, and (b) discharging the three hypotheses at each concrete algorithm (here Kosaraju). The obligation it creates is that every instantiation must re-supply uniq_flatten, all_in_flatten and class_symconnect; a new SCC algorithm whose correctness lemma does not expose exactly these three facts cannot use sccs_acyclicE without an adapter lemma. The Kosaraju instantiation is pure glue (rewrite + case), so any failure of acyclicity must lie in one of the two lemmas, not in the parent.
